notes.title: 🎃2022할로윈 후즈후에서 즐겨요!!🎃
notes.notes:
후럭이 여러분 안녕하세요
할로윈을 맞이하여 후즈후가 완.전.히 새로워진 모습으로 찾아왔습니다!!
새로워진 분위기의 모드와 놓치면 후회할 소장가치 100% 스킨이 업데이트 되었습니다.

더불어, 기존에 발견되었던 버그 픽스 및 기존 모드 개편작업도 함께 완료 되었습니다.

버그 픽스 및 UI개선
• 로딩 버그 개선 : 이제 로딩창에서 다른 플레이어의 로딩 상태를 확인 할 수 있습니다.
• 비공개방 생성시 공개방 진입 불가한 현상 해결
• 방장이 NPC와는 충돌하고 플레이어는 통과하는 현상 해결
• 가끔 튜토리얼에서 기타 게임 모드로 변경하지 못하는 이슈를 해결하였습니다
• 경찰과 도둑의 맵 밸런싱을 하였습니다. 승률을 기반으로 보물들의 위치를 조정하였습니다.

밸런스 패치 및 모드 개편 : 폭탄돌리기모드
💣폭탄돌리기모드가 새롭게 개편 되었습니다💣
기존에 폭탄 돌리기에서 폭탄을 가지고 있는 플레이어가 진짜 플레이어를 찾는게 힘들어, 폭탄을 주고받는 시간이 길어지는 문제가 있었습니다. 
그!래!서 새로운 룰을 추가하여 더 재미있고 스릴 있게 즐길 수 있도록 했습니다.

•  폭탄을 넘길 때마다 기존 +8초가 되던 시간 카운트가 조정되었습니다⏱️이 전 보다 훨씬 긴박하게 조정 되었으니 빠르게 폭탄을 넘기세요!

🐦이게 왠 새야!?🐦
•  이 모드에서는 연기를 오래 지속할 수 없습니다 눈치 없는 새가 당신을 방해하기 위해 찾아 옵니다.
•  여러분은 이제 연기를 지속 할 수 없어요 들키지 않으려면 어떻게든 이 눈치 없는 새를 쫒아야겠죠?🐦

NEW MODE 
🧛창백한 자들의 밤🧛
축축하고 으스스한 분위기의 맵 에서 뱀파이어를 마주하세요.
• 당신과 진짜 플레이어들은 뱀파이어가 됩니다.
• 3초마다 일정량의 피가 줄어듭니다.
• 다른 뱀파이어를 공격하거나 혈청 아이템을🩸사용하여 줄어든 피를 채우세요!
• 공격당하면 마술이 발동 되어 일정시간 동안 당신은 투명해 질 수 있습니다.

신규스킨
🎃할로윈🎃을 맞이하여 새로운 스킨이 추가 되었습니다

단! 할로윈기간 한.정 지금이 아니면 이렇게 멋진 스킨들을 다시는 얻을 수 없어요!

• 할로윈 기간 한정 무료 스킨입니다 플레이업적을 통해 해금 할 수 있습니다.
• 이 스킨들은 할로윈이 지나면 획득 할 수 없습니다 빠르게 쟁취하세요.

NEW SKIN
1. 🧛뱀파이어🧛
• 고스족 풍 의 귀엽고 멋진 여자 뱀파이어 스킨을 만날 수 있습니다.
• 기존 캐릭터에서는 볼 수 없었던 피부톤, 눈동자 색, 복장을 가지고 있습니다.

2. 💀사신💀
• Who’s Who? 에서만 만나 보실 수 있는 캐주얼하고 힙하게 변신한 사신 캐릭터 입니다.
• 기존 캐릭터에서는 볼 수 없었던 마스크와 낫을 착용 하고 있습니다.

이번 업데이트는 🎃할로윈을 맞이해 여러분에게 새롭고 으스스한 재미를 선사해 드릴 것 입니다.
새롭게 공개 된 스킨과 모드에 대해 궁금한 점이 있으시다면 질문을 남겨주세요. 빠른 답변을 통해 궁금증을 해소 해 드리겠습니다.
더불어, 여러분이 보내주신 관심에 힘입어 Who's Who?가 많은 사랑을 받고 있습니다
많은 스트리머분들이 플레이 영상을 업로드 해 주고 계신데요, 저희도 업로드 되는 영상을 매일 확인하며 빵빵 터지고 있습니다 감사합니다💗
그럼, 저희는 개발에 매진하며 추가적인 게임 컨텐츠와 편의성 개편으로 다시 오겠습니다!!
저희는 여러분의 스릴이 오래 지속 될 수 있도록 노력하겠습니다!
감사합니다!

🕸️🕷️👻Have a creepy Who’s who day👻🕸️

notes.title: Who's Who? Halloween Update!
notes.notes:
[h2]🎃Enjoy Your 2022 Halloween in Who's Who!🎃[/h2]

Dear Non-NPCs,

We are back with a [b]brand new update[/b] to celebrate the Halloween season! We have added a new mode that fits perfectly with the spooky atmosphere of Halloween, along with two new character skins that you don't want to miss!

[h2]Updates and Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Loading bug - you can now see the status of other players’ connection while loading
[*] Fixed an issue where only private rooms were being created
[*] Fixed a bug where the room host could walk through other players
[*] Fixed an issue where players could not select a game mode while in the tutorial
[*] Changed the location of jewels in Police and Thief mode to better balance the mode between different maps
[/list]
[h2]💣Bombs Away Mode Changes💣[/h2]

Remember how you would desperately try to find a person to pass the bomb too, only to have it blow up on you because your fellow non-NPCs are too good at acting? 

Those days are gone! We have added new a rule, and some modifications, to Bombs Away which will help players to find other players more easily.These changes should help make the mode more balanced, and more fun, whether you have the bomb or not!

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Previously, passing the bomb added 8 seconds to the bomb’s timer. It has been adjusted to add fewere seconds which makes the bomb tick faster.
[*] To prevent players from standing still the whole time, we’ve added a bird that will circle a player’s head if they stand still for too long.
[*] Once the player begins moving again, the bird will leave, meaning you have to be strategic in where, and for how long, you stand in one place.
[/list]
[h2]🧛Thirst For Blood Mode🧛[/h2]

We have decorated some of our current maps to match the creepy Halloween atmosphere. However, beware of the vampires that lurk in the night!

[h3]Details:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Play as a vampire
[*] Every 3 seconds, you will lose some blood. Once you run out, you’ll faint.
[*] Find, and kick, other vampires to get more blood, or use the blood vessel item to fill your meter.
[*] Don’t worry! If you get hit, vampire magic will teleport you to safety.
[/list]
[h2]🎃New Character Skins🎃 [/h2]

We’ve added two new character skins to the game! These skins can only be obtained during the Halloween seasonal event [b](00:00AM UTC November 8th)[/b]. The skins can be obtained by completing the required achievements. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41616265/25546e78f1f2830021e500811d40d3efa1432687.png[/img]

[h3]Vampire skin:[/h3]
[list]
[*] She’s a cute and pretty Vampire wearing a Gothic dress
[*] She has ruby-red eyes, wings, and a pale skin tone that makes her truly a creature of the night!
[/list]
[h3]Reaper skin:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The reaper decided to be a bit more hip and stylish!
[*] He is wearing a unique reaper mask with his signature sickle on his back. 
[/list]
This Halloween update will bring fun new content for you all to enjoy! If you have any questions regarding the update, please feel free to let us know in discord or in the discussion threads. Along with it, We would like to thank all the streamers and content creators for making videos of our game.Our crew members enjoy watching the videos and laughing our hearts out at all the crazy antics! We will be coming back soon with more game content and convenience updates, so please stay posted!

[h2]🕸️Have a creepy Who's Who Day🕸️[/h2]

notes.title: Check Out Our New Lobby Feature on the "Who's Who?" Discord!
notes.notes:
We heard you, non-NPCs!

Since our release, one piece of feedback that we have received from you all is that there is no lobby browser in game to help you find lobbies that are full or close to full. We understand your frustration, and we appreciate you all bringing this feedback to us.

In order to address this issue in the short term, [b]we have implemented a "lobby" system in our Discord[/b]. For each of the servers (US, Europe, and Asia) there will be several premade voice channels that you can join that are expressly for finding groups of players to play with.

With this system, you can see groups of players in the Discord, and use this as a way to "browse" lobbies, and see the number of players in a given room. This way, you will not have to wait for a lobby to fill up on its own. While this is not the most elegant fix, we think that it will make your experience playing "Who's Who?" smoother, and get you into full games faster. Eventually, we hope to be able to implement this as a full feature in the game at a later point.

See you on the server, non-NPCs!

- The G1Playground Team

Join us on Discord [url=https://bit.ly/3CLPJBx]here[/url]

notes.title: Post-Release Updates, Bug Fixes, and Road Map
notes.notes:
Hello Non-NPCs! 

Thank you so much for all the love and support for [b]"Who's Who?"[/b] during the few weeks since we've released the game. We know many of you have been curious about our plans for the game, so we would like to share some insights regarding new features and content coming in future updates. 
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
We apologize to all of the players who have suffered from in-game bugs. We currently have a list of most of the issues, and will be releasing small updates as we fix them. Here are the first batch of fixes that we have planned:

[h3]Planned Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Loading screen bug
[*] Teleport bug
[*] Hawk-eye item bug
[*] Bug where Characters would get stuck in the wall 
[/list]
[h2]Convenience updates[/h2]
Many of our players have requested a communication function while in the lobby. So we are planning to add a feature allowing players to communicate with each other in the lobby with Emojis. We are also planning to add a result page to congratulate the players who have won in each round. Finally, we are going to add the ability to select random game modes within a lobby.

[h3]Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Emoji to be added in lobby
[*] Round result page to be added
[*] Random game mode to be added
[/list]
[h2]Content Roadmap[/h2]
Good news, non-NPC's! We are also sharing some of our plans for additional post-release content below. First, we will add [b]2 new game modes[/b], to be announced at a future date. Furthermore, to celebrate the Halloween season, we are planning to add [b]some Halloween-themed skins[/b] to the game for your enjoyment!

We are also evaluating was to adjust the mechanics of the Bombs Away mode to make it even more enjoyable to play. We have also heard about the balance issue in Police and Thief mode, and will adjust the balance of the game as well. While we can't currently give an exact date for the new content and gameplay adjustments, we are working hard to bring these exciting updates to the game as soon as possible!

Finally, we are pleased to announce that we are planning to port "Who's Who?" to the [b]Switch, Xbox, and PlayStation 5[/b] sometime around the end of the year! 

[h3]Roadmap Highlights:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adding two new modes
[*] Adding Halloween-themed skins
[*] Bombs Away Mode : Game mechanics adjustment
[*] Police and Thief mode : game balancing
[/list]
We appreciate all the non-NPCs who have given their feedback to us to help make the game even better post-release. Stay tuned here, and on our Discord, for more news regarding future "Who's Who?" updates! 

Thank you,
The G1Playground Team

notes.title: Who's Who? - Price Change
notes.notes:
Hey non-NPCs!

After careful consideration, we have decided to lower the price of “Who’s Who?” to [b]$4.99 USD[/b].

We want to be sure that the price of our game reflects the value, and we currently believe that our initial price of [b]$10.99 USD[/b] does not align with the current content in the game. While we will be continuing development on the game, and have plans to add more content to the game in the future, we want every player to feel confident in the purchase they are making, and that means adjusting our price tag in the meantime. 

We also want to be sure every player who purchased “Who’s Who?” before the pricing change is compensated. As a thank you for your support, we will be sending [b]two additional keys[/b] to these players. If you purchased “Who’s Who?” at the initial price of [b]$10.99 USD[/b], please send us [u]your purchase record and your Steam Community profile to g1official@g1playground.com[/u]. 

Thank you everyone for your invaluable feedback and continuous support!

notes.title: Who’s Who Is Finally Out!
notes.notes:
Gather around Non-NPCs! Today’s the big day! 

The wait is finally over, as we’re excited to announce that “[b]Who’s Who?[/b]” is now available on Steam! Play with up to 10 of your fellow non-NPCs as you do your best to act like an NPC, figure out who the other players are and, of course, dropkick your friends! Are you ready for the most hilariously fun and action-packed multiplayer game out there?   

Join your fellow non-NPCs in 4 seriously entertaining game modes:

“[b]Where’s Everybody?[/b]”: In this classic free-for-all mode, players attempt to blend in with the various NPCs while trying to find (and dropkick) the other players! Do you have what it takes to be the last one standing?

“[b]Police vs Thieves[/b]”: A team of thieving non-NPCs attempt to steal all the precious gems on display while the team of police try to stop them! A classic game of cops and robbers!

“[b]The Squad[/b]”: Team-based action at its best! Work with your fellow Non-NPCs to eliminate the enemy team before they eliminate you!

“[b]Bombs Away![/b]”: You have to be quick in this hot potato game! One player has a ticking time-bomb, and the only way they can pass it on is by finding another Non-NPC and dropkicking them. This one is definitely a blast!  

We wanted to thank all you non-NPCs for all your support! Now go out there and show your friends what you’ve got!

[previewyoutube=C2p7Fh9i2C8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Who’s Who? Launch Date Announced!
notes.notes:
Greetings Non-NPCs!

notes.title: Is It You? Demo Out Now!
notes.notes:
Greetings Non-NPCs! 

Are you ready to dropkick your friends into oblivion? Then you’re in luck - Our Demo for Is It You? Is now available to play, for one week only, exclusively in Steam’s Next Festival!

[previewyoutube=Y8CvxjY5KvQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Play solo or together with up to 10 friends on this multiplayer NPC hide and seek game, as you fight to find all the real players hidden among the NPCs and become the last survivors! But you have to be careful. You can't get caught either! Our Demo includes the following features:

[b]Police and Thief Mode:[/b]

There are many wonderful treasures on display in the museum! You can become a thief and steal treasures secretly from the police or if you don't like it, be a Police officer and catch the thieves.

[b]Where’s Everybody Mode:[/b]

In a space where everyone pretends to be an NPC, look for people who behave weirdly! You should never let your guard down until you become the last one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41616265/302db011add290553c53578283efd2fb69297530.jpg[/img]

So come join us for a week of fun, laughter, and non-stop pretending, exclusively in Is It You?.
